phase1_paper2_general.name: Syllabus for Paper 2 of Phase I in General Stream

subjects.name: General knowledge, Current events of national and international importance
Economic and social development
sub: Growth and Development: measurement of growth (National Income, per capita income); Poverty Alleviation and Employment Generation; Sustainable Development and Environmental issues
Social Structure in India: Multiculturalism; Demographic Trends; Urbanisation and Migration; Gender Issues - Social Justice

subjects.name: Commerce and Accountancy
sub: Accounting as a financial information system
Accounting Standards: Depreciation, Inventories, Revenue Recognition, Fixed Assets, Foreign Exchange Transactions, Investments
Cash Flow Statement, Fund Flow Statement, financial statement analysis, ratio analysis
Accounting for Share Capital Transactions including Bonus Shares, Right Shares
Employees Stock Option and Buy-Back of Securities
Preparation and Presentation of Company Final Accounts

subjects.name: Management
sub: Management nature and scope; Management Processes: Planning, Organization, Staffing, Directing, Controlling
Role of a Manager; Leadership tasks
Leadership Styles; Leadership Theories; successful vs effective leader
Human Resource Development: concept, goals
Motivation, Morale and Incentives: theories of motivation; morale factors; role of incentives
Communication: process steps, channels, oral vs written, verbal vs non-verbal, upward/downward/lateral, barriers, role of IT
Corporate Governance: factors and mechanisms

subjects.name: Finance
sub: Financial System: role and functions of regulatory bodies
Financial Markets: primary and secondary (Forex, Money, Bond, Equity), functions, instruments, recent developments
Basics of Derivatives: Forward, Futures and Swap
Recent Developments in the Financial Sector
Financial Inclusion - use of technology
Alternate source of finance, private and social cost-benefit, Public-Private Partnership
Direct and Indirect taxes; Non-tax sources of Revenue, GST, Finance Commission, Fiscal Policy, FRBM Act
Inflation: definition, trends, estimates, consequences, remedies; WPI and CPI components and trends
Financial Risk Management

subjects.name: Costing
sub: Overview of Cost and Management Accounting
Methods of Costing: Unit, Job, Batch, Contract, Process/Operation, Service Sectors
Basics of Cost Control and Analysis: Standard Costing, Marginal Costing, Budget and Budgetary Control
Lean System and Innovation: Lean intro, JIT, Kaizen Costing, 5S, TPM, Cellular Manufacturing/One-Piece Flow, Six Sigma, Process Innovation and BPR

subjects.name: Indian Economy & Global Economy
sub: Demand and Supply; Market Structures; National Income concepts and measurement; Classical & Keynesian approach; Consumption, Investment, Multiplier and Accelerator; Demand and Supply for Money; IS-LM; Inflation and Phillips Curve; Business Cycles
Balance of Payments; Foreign Exchange Markets; Inflation; Monetary and Fiscal Policy; Non-banking Financial Institutions
Role of International Financial Institutions: BIS, IOSCO, IMF & World Bank

subjects.name: Central Government's initiatives/schemes in the financial sector

phase2_paper2_general.name: Syllabus for Paper 2 of Phase II in General Stream

subjects.name: IFSCA Act, IFSCA, IFSC, GIFT IFSC, GIFT City and Global Financial Centres
Union Budget - Concepts, approach and broad trends & Economic Survey
Banking
sub: Structure and Functions of Financial Institutions
Functions of Reserve Bank of India
Banking System in India - Structure and Developments; Financial Institutions - SIDBI, EXIM Bank, NABARD, NHB, NaBFID etc.
Recent Developments in Global Financial System and impact on Indian Financial System
Role of Information Technology in Banking and Finance
Non-Banking System
Developments in Digital Payments

subjects.name: Capital Market
sub: Role and Functions of Regulatory bodies in Financial Sector
Primary and Secondary Markets (Forex, Money, Bond, Equity etc.), functions, instruments, recent developments
Basics of Derivatives: Forward, Futures and Swap
Spot and Derivative market of Precious Metals

subjects.name: Insurance
sub: History of Indian Insurance; principles of insurance
Risk and uncertainty; pooling and diversification; indemnity and insurable interest
Legal foundations; Group/Health Insurance/Pensions; intermediation role; bancassurance in India
Insurer functions: product design, pricing, distribution, underwriting, claims, investment, reinsurance

Insurance lines: Property-Liability, Life and Annuities, Health; liability risks; valuation and solvency; specialist lines (Agricultural, Export Credit Guarantee); reinsurance, GIC of India, obligator sessions, retention within country

subjects.name: Pension Sector
sub: Status of pension sector in India
Types of retirement schemes and their features
National Pension System
Atal Pension Yojana
Annuity Plans
Basics of investment

phase1_paper2_legal.name: Paper 2 of Phase I - Legal Stream
subjects: Constitution of India - Preamble, Part I, III, IV, IVA, V, VI, VIII, IXA, IXB, XI
Contract Laws - Indian Contract Act 1872; Sale of Goods Act 1930; Indian Partnership Act 1932; Specific Relief Act 1963
Code of Civil Procedure 1908 (Part I-V, VII, Schedule 1)
Transfer of Property Act 1882 (Chapters III-V)
Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996 (Part I and II)
Administrative Law
Jurisprudence and Interpretation of Statutes
Important Latin terms and maxims
Law of Torts and Consumer Protection Act 2019
The Special Economic Zone Act 2005
The Digital Data Protection Act 2023
The Right to Information Act 2005
The Mediation Act 2023
Intellectual Property Rights (basic concepts)

phase2_paper2_legal.name: Paper 2 of Phase II - Legal Stream
subjects: Criminal Laws - Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023 (Chapters I, II, III, IV, VII, XII, XVII, XIX); Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023
Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023
Corporate Laws - Companies Act 2013; LLP Act 2008; Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016 (Part I-II); Law of Trusts

IFSCA Act and 13 Acts: RBI Act 1934; Insurance Act 1938; Banking Regulation Act 1949; SCRA 1956; DICGC Act 1961; SEBI Act 1992; Depositories Act 1996; IRDAI Act 1999; FEMA 1999; CIC Act 2005; PSS Act 2007; PFRDA Act 2013; Factoring Regulation Act 2011

phase2_paper1.name: Paper 1 of Phase II - English Writing Skills
phase2_paper1.note: Framed to assess writing skills including expression and understanding of the topic, including precis writing, essay writing and comprehension.

it_stream.name: Paper 2 for Information Technology Stream (Common for both Phases)
subjects: Database Concepts: ER-model; relational model, relational algebra, tuple calculus, integrity constraints, normal forms; file organization, indexing (B and B+ trees), transactions and concurrency control
SQL Queries: select, view, truncate, delete, update, alter, inner join, outer joins, aggregate functions, union, intersection, except, in and exist, nested queries
Programming Concepts (Java/C/C++): control, scope, binding, parameter passing, functional and logic programming, OOP, inheritance, class/object, constructors, functions, exception handling
Data Analytics Languages (Python/R): regex, slicing, reshaping, dataframes, dictionaries/sets, file management, classes/functions, data mining, lists, import/export, charts
Algorithms: tree/graph traversals, connected components, spanning trees, shortest paths, hashing, sorting, searching, greedy/dynamic programming/divide-and-conquer
Networking Concepts: ISO/OSI stack, LAN technologies, TCP/UDP/IP, switches/gateways/routers, application protocols (DNS, SMTP, POP, FTP, HTTP), firewalls
Information & Cyber Security: cyber attacks, software development security, network security, authentication, CIA, network audit, systems audit
Data warehousing: extraction, cleaning, transformation, loading, metadata, data cube, data mart, data models
Shell Programming: basics, variables, arguments, if, loop, return, UNIX commands

AI/ML: supervised/unsupervised learning, preprocessing, model evaluation, linear/logistic regression, decision trees, clustering, feature engineering, Python ML, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, NLP, sentiment analysis, neural networks, overfitting/underfitting, cross-validation, reinforcement learning, cloud AI, deployment basics

sebi.note: SEBI stream subjects pooled in Phase 1 Paper 2 and Phase 2 Paper 2: Commerce & Accountancy, Management, Finance, Costing, Companies Act, Economics; Phase 1 Paper 1: GA, English, Quant, Reasoning.
